ex.en: Most scientific breakthroughs are nothing else than the discovery of the obvious.
ex.zh: 大多數科學突破，不過是發現了顯而易見的事。

ex.en: After many years of grueling training, she finally made a breakthrough and won the championship.
ex.zh: 經過多年艱苦訓練，她終於有所突破，奪得冠軍。

ex.en: What's your favorite web browser?
ex.zh: 你最喜歡哪個瀏覽器？

ex.en: Not all internet browsers are safe.
ex.zh: 不是所有的網路瀏覽器都是安全的。

ex.en: The browser is running really slowly.
ex.zh: 瀏覽器跑得超慢。

ex.en: I left my briefcase in the bus.
ex.zh: 我把公事包忘在公車上了。

ex.en: My briefcase is full of papers.
ex.zh: 我的公事包裡塞滿了文件。

ex.en: He opened his briefcase and took out a contract.
ex.zh: 他打開公事包，拿出一份合約。

ex.en: I hear you've already contacted the broker.
ex.zh: 聽說您已經跟仲介聯絡過了。

ex.en: My insurance broker found me a better plan.
ex.zh: 我的保險經紀人幫我找到更好的方案。

broker.zh: 促成（協議、交易）、居中協調

ex.en: Our firm brokered the deal between the two companies.
ex.zh: 我們公司促成了兩家公司之間的交易。

ex.en: She helped broker an agreement with the supplier.
ex.zh: 她幫忙促成了和供應商的協議。

ex.en: The brake stopped working.
ex.zh: 煞車失靈了。

ex.en: I'll only buy the car if they fix the brakes first.
ex.zh: 除非他們先把煞車修好，否則我不會買那輛車。

ex.en: Tom slammed on the brakes and the car began to skid.
ex.zh: 湯姆猛踩煞車，車子開始打滑。

ex.en: The driver braked suddenly to avoid the dog.
ex.zh: 司機為了閃避那隻狗突然煞車。

ex.en: Brake gently when the road is wet.
ex.zh: 路面濕滑時要輕踩煞車。

ex.en: I can't find the broom.
ex.zh: 我找不到掃把。

ex.en: She brought a broom.
ex.zh: 她拿來了一支掃把。

ex.en: Traveling abroad can broaden your horizons.
ex.zh: 出國旅行可以開闊你的視野。

ex.en: The company plans to broaden its product range.
ex.zh: 公司計畫擴大產品線。

ex.en: Broadly speaking, the plan was a success.
ex.zh: 大致來說，這個計畫很成功。

ex.en: I broadly agree with your proposal.
ex.zh: 我大致上同意你的提案。

ex.en: The term is used broadly in the industry.
ex.zh: 這個詞在業界被廣泛使用。

ex.en: The new rules apply broadly to all employees.
ex.zh: 新規定普遍適用於所有員工。

ex.en: She smiled broadly when she heard the news.
ex.zh: 她聽到消息時笑得合不攏嘴。

ex.en: He grinned broadly at the camera.
ex.zh: 他對著鏡頭咧嘴大笑。

ex.en: She works at a brokerage firm.
ex.zh: 她在一家證券公司上班。

ex.en: Online brokerages charge lower fees.
ex.zh: 網路券商收費較低。

ex.en: The brokerage fee is two percent of the sale price.
ex.zh: 仲介費是售價的百分之二。

ex.en: We pay a small brokerage on each trade.
ex.zh: 我們每筆交易都要付一點手續費。

ex.en: Our car had a breakdown on the highway.
ex.zh: 我們的車在高速公路上拋錨了。

ex.en: A machine breakdown stopped production for two hours.
ex.zh: 機器故障讓生產停了兩小時。

ex.en: Can you give me a breakdown of the costs?
ex.zh: 可以給我一份費用明細嗎？

ex.en: The report includes a breakdown by region.
ex.zh: 這份報告附有各地區的細項。

ex.en: There was a breakdown in communication between the teams.
ex.zh: 團隊之間的溝通出了問題。

ex.en: He had a nervous breakdown from stress.
ex.zh: 他因為壓力太大而精神崩潰。

ex.en: The mayor denied having taken a bribe.
ex.zh: 市長否認收受賄賂。

ex.en: Police shouldn't take bribes.
ex.zh: 警察不應該收賄。

ex.en: He tried to bribe the official.
ex.zh: 他試圖賄賂那名官員。

ex.en: They were accused of bribing the inspectors.
ex.zh: 他們被控賄賂檢查人員。

ex.en: Is broadband included in the rent?
ex.zh: 房租有包含寬頻網路嗎？

ex.en: The village still doesn't have broadband access.
ex.zh: 那個村莊至今還沒有寬頻網路。

ex.en: The old house is made of red brick.
ex.zh: 那棟老房子是紅磚蓋的。

ex.en: The workers are laying bricks.
ex.zh: 工人們正在砌磚。

ex.en: Put the phone number in brackets.
ex.zh: 把電話號碼放在括號裡。

ex.en: The old price is shown in brackets.
ex.zh: 原價標示在括號中。

ex.en: He is in a higher tax bracket now.
ex.zh: 他現在屬於較高的稅率級距。

ex.en: This product targets the 25 to 35 age bracket.
ex.zh: 這個產品鎖定 25 到 35 歲的族群。

ex.en: We need a bracket to hang the shelf.
ex.zh: 我們需要一個托架來掛層板。

ex.en: The TV is mounted on a wall bracket.
ex.zh: 電視裝在壁掛架上。

ex.en: We know him to be a brave man.
ex.zh: 我們知道他是個勇敢的人。

ex.en: I think she is very brave.
ex.zh: 我覺得她很勇敢。

ex.en: I'm not as brave as Tom.
ex.zh: 我沒有湯姆那麼勇敢。

brave.zh: 冒著（惡劣天氣等）、勇敢面對

ex.en: We braved the rain to see the fireworks.
ex.zh: 我們冒雨去看煙火。

ex.en: Thousands of fans braved the cold to see the concert.
ex.zh: 數千名歌迷不畏寒冷去看演唱會。

brutal.zh: 殘酷的、嚴酷的；毫不留情的

ex.en: The competition in this industry is brutal.
ex.zh: 這個產業的競爭非常殘酷。

ex.en: The summer heat this year was brutal.
ex.zh: 今年夏天熱得要命。

ex.en: He gave me some brutal but honest feedback.
ex.zh: 他給了我一些毫不留情但很中肯的意見。

ex.en: What do you say to bringing your sister?
ex.zh: 帶你姊姊一起來怎麼樣？

ex.en: Please bring your ID card.
ex.zh: 請攜帶身分證。

ex.en: What you did brought disgrace on the whole class.
ex.zh: 你的行為讓全班蒙羞。

ex.en: The new policy brought many changes.
ex.zh: 新政策帶來了許多改變。

ex.en: My wife's part-time job brings in a little extra money.
ex.zh: 我太太的兼職工作帶來一些額外收入。

ex.en: The new product brought in a lot of money.
ex.zh: 新產品賺進了很多錢。

ex.en: She brought up an interesting point.
ex.zh: 她提出了一個有趣的論點。

ex.en: Don't bring up that topic at dinner.
ex.zh: 吃晚餐時別提那個話題。

ex.en: I intend to visit Australia during my spring break.
ex.zh: 我打算春假時去澳洲玩。

ex.en: Let's take a ten-minute break.
ex.zh: 我們休息十分鐘吧。

ex.en: I must apologize to you for breaking the vase.
ex.zh: 把你的花瓶打破了，真對不起。

ex.en: He got a broken jaw and lost some teeth.
ex.zh: 他的下巴骨折，還掉了幾顆牙。

ex.en: He must be fined if he breaks the law.
ex.zh: 如果他違法，就應該被罰款。

ex.en: You shouldn't break your promise.
ex.zh: 你不應該違背承諾。

ex.en: The fire broke out after the staff went home.
ex.zh: 員工下班回家後發生了火災。

ex.en: A fire broke out in the warehouse.
ex.zh: 倉庫發生了火災。

ex.en: My car broke down on the highway.
ex.zh: 我的車在高速公路上拋錨了。

ex.en: The printer broke down again.
ex.zh: 印表機又壞了。

ex.en: My brother is holding a camera in his hand.
ex.zh: 我弟弟手裡拿著一台相機。

ex.en: How many sisters do you have? How many brothers?
ex.zh: 你有幾個姊妹？幾個兄弟？

ex.en: I promised to help my brother with his homework.
ex.zh: 我答應幫弟弟做功課。

ex.en: Memory is an essential function of our brain.
ex.zh: 記憶是大腦的一項重要功能。

ex.en: As people get older, their brain cells become less efficient.
ex.zh: 隨著年紀增長，腦細胞的效率會變差。

ex.en: Reading is good exercise for your brain.
ex.zh: 閱讀是很好的大腦運動。

ex.en: That boy has good brains.
ex.zh: 那個男孩很聰明。

ex.en: She is the brains behind the project.
ex.zh: 她是這個專案的靈魂人物。

ex.en: Could you give us a brief introduction of yourself?
ex.zh: 你能簡單介紹一下自己嗎？

ex.en: Let's take a brief look at this topic.
ex.zh: 我們來簡單看一下這個主題。

ex.en: We had a brief meeting this morning.
ex.zh: 我們今天早上開了一個簡短的會議。

ex.en: The manager will brief us on the new project.
ex.zh: 經理會向我們簡報新專案。

ex.en: Please brief the team before the client arrives.
ex.zh: 請在客戶到之前先向團隊說明情況。

ex.en: He gave his reasons in brief.
ex.zh: 他簡要地說明了理由。

ex.en: In brief, the project was a success.
ex.zh: 簡單來說，這個專案很成功。

ex.en: Tom has very broad shoulders.
ex.zh: 湯姆的肩膀很寬。

ex.en: The river is very broad at this point.
ex.zh: 這條河在這一段非常寬。

ex.en: Broad safety measures were put into effect.
ex.zh: 廣泛的安全措施已開始實施。

ex.en: We should judge matters on a broader basis.
ex.zh: 我們應該從更宏觀的角度來判斷事情。

ex.en: The store offers a broad range of products.
ex.zh: 這家店提供種類廣泛的商品。

broad.zh: in broad daylight：光天化日之下

ex.en: He had his car stolen in broad daylight.
ex.zh: 他的車在光天化日之下被偷了。

ex.en: Today, robbers robbed another bank in broad daylight.
ex.zh: 今天又有搶匪在光天化日之下搶了一家銀行。

ex.en: A new branch will be opened in Chicago next month.
ex.zh: 下個月將在芝加哥開一家新分店。

ex.en: Our branches extend all over the country.
ex.zh: 我們的分店遍布全國。

ex.en: The lamp was suspended from the branch of a tree.
ex.zh: 燈籠掛在樹枝上。

ex.en: The willow branches swayed gently in the breeze.
ex.zh: 柳枝在微風中輕輕搖曳。

ex.en: The company is branching out into online sales.
ex.zh: 公司正把業務拓展到網路銷售。

ex.en: The road branches off to the left.
ex.zh: 道路在左邊分岔。

ex.en: The lake was gleaming in the bright sunshine.
ex.zh: 湖水在燦爛的陽光下閃閃發亮。

ex.en: That tiny star there is the brightest out of all the stars.
ex.zh: 那顆小星星是所有星星裡最亮的。

ex.en: I remember him as a cute, bright little boy.
ex.zh: 在我印象中，他是個可愛又聰明的小男孩。

ex.en: She's one of the brightest students in the class.
ex.zh: 她是班上最聰明的學生之一。

ex.en: The minute I have something to drink, I turn bright red.
ex.zh: 我一喝酒就會滿臉通紅。

ex.en: She was wearing a bright yellow dress.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件鮮黃色的洋裝。

ex.en: The company has a bright future.
ex.zh: 這家公司前景光明。

ex.en: Try to look on the bright side.
ex.zh: 試著往好的方面想。

ex.en: I'll go with you as far as the bridge.
ex.zh: 我陪你走到橋那邊。

ex.en: I don't know the exact length of this bridge.
ex.zh: 我不知道這座橋確切有多長。

bridge.zh: 彌合、縮小（差距）（bridge the gap）

ex.en: The program helps bridge the gap between school and work.
ex.zh: 這個計畫幫助銜接學校與職場之間的落差。

ex.en: We need to bridge the gap between the two teams.
ex.zh: 我們需要縮小兩個團隊之間的隔閡。

bridge.zh: cross that bridge when we come to it：到時候再說

ex.en: We'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
ex.zh: 船到橋頭自然直。

ex.en: Let's not worry about it yet; we'll cross that bridge when we come to it.
ex.zh: 先別擔心，到時候再說吧。

ex.en: If you quit the job, you'll be burning your bridges.
ex.zh: 如果你辭掉這份工作，就等於自斷後路。

ex.en: Don't burn your bridges with your former employer.
ex.zh: 別跟前雇主把關係搞僵。

ex.en: She hid behind the door and held her breath.
ex.zh: 她躲在門後，屏住呼吸。

ex.en: Tom is still too out of breath to speak.
ex.zh: 湯姆還喘得說不出話來。

ex.en: Take a deep breath and relax.
ex.zh: 深呼吸，放輕鬆。

ex.en: I am hungry because I did not eat breakfast.
ex.zh: 我沒吃早餐，所以肚子很餓。

ex.en: I'd like breakfast in my room at 8 sharp.
ex.zh: 我想在八點整於房間裡吃早餐。

ex.en: Many young people in Japan eat bread for breakfast.
ex.zh: 很多日本年輕人早餐吃麵包。

ex.en: I'd like to have a test for breast cancer.
ex.zh: 我想做乳癌檢查。

ex.en: He doesn't drink enough breast milk.
ex.zh: 他喝的母乳不夠。

ex.en: Tom eats rice every day either with fish or with chicken breast.
ex.zh: 湯姆每天吃飯不是配魚就是配雞胸肉。

ex.en: Grill the chicken breast for ten minutes.
ex.zh: 雞胸肉烤十分鐘。

ex.en: Did you see a brown wallet around here?
ex.zh: 你有在這附近看到一個咖啡色的皮夾嗎？

ex.en: Who is the woman in the brown coat?
ex.zh: 那個穿棕色外套的女人是誰？

ex.en: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
ex.zh: 敏捷的棕色狐狸跳過了那隻懶狗。

ex.en: The room was painted in shades of brown.
ex.zh: 這個房間漆成深淺不一的棕色。

ex.en: For shoes, she prefers brown to black.
ex.zh: 買鞋子時，她比較喜歡棕色而不是黑色。

ex.en: I want to breathe some fresh air.
ex.zh: 我想呼吸一下新鮮空氣。

ex.en: The air we breathe consists of oxygen and nitrogen.
ex.zh: 我們呼吸的空氣由氧氣和氮氣組成。

ex.en: Breathe deeply and try to relax.
ex.zh: 深呼吸，試著放鬆。

breathe.zh: breathe a sigh of relief：鬆一口氣

ex.en: We all breathed a big sigh of relief.
ex.zh: 我們都大大鬆了一口氣。

ex.en: Everyone breathed a sigh of relief when the project was finished.
ex.zh: 專案完成時，大家都鬆了一口氣。

ex.en: What breed is your dog?
ex.zh: 你的狗是什麼品種？

ex.en: This breed of cattle produces high-quality milk.
ex.zh: 這個品種的牛能產出優質牛奶。

ex.en: A few months later they return to their breeding grounds in the Arctic.
ex.zh: 幾個月後，牠們會回到北極的繁殖地。

ex.en: He breeds horses on his farm.
ex.zh: 他在農場養馬。

ex.en: Filth breeds illnesses.
ex.zh: 髒亂會滋生疾病。

ex.en: Clear water breeds no fish.
ex.zh: 水至清則無魚。

ex.en: He thought of a brilliant idea.
ex.zh: 他想到了一個絕妙的點子。

ex.en: Suddenly she had a brilliant inspiration.
ex.zh: 她突然有了一個絕妙的靈感。

ex.en: She is a brilliant engineer.
ex.zh: 她是一位才華洋溢的工程師。

ex.en: The room was filled with brilliant sunshine.
ex.zh: 房間裡灑滿了燦爛的陽光。

ex.en: She wore a dress in brilliant red.
ex.zh: 她穿著一件鮮紅色的洋裝。

ex.en: Many young people in Japan eat bread for breakfast.
ex.zh: 很多日本年輕人早餐吃麵包。

ex.en: There is an oven to bake bread in the kitchen.
ex.zh: 廚房裡有烤箱可以烤麵包。

ex.en: Because Mary was hungry, she bought some bread.
ex.zh: 瑪麗餓了，所以買了一些麵包。

ex.en: We spoke briefly.
ex.zh: 我們簡短地聊了一下。

ex.en: She glanced briefly at the newspaper.
ex.zh: 她很快地瞄了一眼報紙。

ex.en: To put it briefly, I do not agree.
ex.zh: 簡單來說，我不同意。

ex.en: She said that she brushes her teeth every morning.
ex.zh: 她說她每天早上都會刷牙。

ex.en: Last night, I went to bed without brushing my teeth.
ex.zh: 昨晚我沒刷牙就去睡了。

ex.en: Jack brushed the dust off his coat.
ex.zh: 傑克把外套上的灰塵刷掉。

ex.en: I've bought a new palette and a few paint brushes.
ex.zh: 我買了一個新的調色盤和幾支畫筆。

ex.en: Use a soft brush to clean the screen.
ex.zh: 用軟毛刷清潔螢幕。

ex.en: I would like to brush up my English.
ex.zh: 我想加強一下我的英文。

ex.en: I need to brush up on my French before the trip.
ex.zh: 出發前我得複習一下法文。

browse.zh: 隨便看看、瀏覽（商品、網頁）

ex.en: I'm just browsing.
ex.zh: 我只是隨便看看。

ex.en: I spent an hour browsing in the bookstore.
ex.zh: 我在書店裡逛了一個小時。

ex.en: His death was broadcast all over the world.
ex.zh: 他過世的消息傳遍了全世界。

ex.en: We broadcast news on the hour.
ex.zh: 我們每個整點播報新聞。

ex.en: That program is now being broadcast.
ex.zh: 那個節目現在正在播出。

ex.en: We watched a live broadcast of the concert.
ex.zh: 我們看了演唱會的現場直播。

ex.en: The news broadcast starts at seven.
ex.zh: 新聞節目七點開始。

ex.en: Which brand of toilet paper do you usually buy?
ex.zh: 你通常買哪個牌子的衛生紙？

ex.en: I want a reliable brand that has good reviews.
ex.zh: 我想要評價好、可靠的品牌。

ex.en: The bags from this brand are too expensive.
ex.zh: 這個牌子的包包太貴了。

ex.en: I bought a set of brand new speakers.
ex.zh: 我買了一套新的音響。

ex.en: The brand new pen is easy to use.
ex.zh: 這支全新的筆很好寫。

ex.en: The campaign helped increase brand awareness.
ex.zh: 這次活動幫助提升了品牌知名度。

ex.en: Social media is a cheap way to build brand awareness.
ex.zh: 社群媒體是建立品牌知名度的便宜方法。

ex.en: Could you send me a brochure?
ex.zh: 可以寄一份簡介手冊給我嗎？

ex.en: I picked up a few brochures at the visitor center.
ex.zh: 我在遊客中心拿了幾份簡介手冊。

breathtaking.zh: 美得令人屏息的、驚人的

ex.en: Thousands of workers and artisans toiled for 22 years to create this breathtaking white marble structure.
ex.zh: 數千名工人和工匠辛勤工作了 22 年，才打造出這座令人驚歎的白色大理石建築。

ex.en: The view from the top was breathtaking.
ex.zh: 從山頂看出去的景色美得令人屏息。

ex.en: My leg was broken in a traffic accident.
ex.zh: 我在一場交通意外中折斷了腿。

ex.en: He got a broken jaw and lost some teeth.
ex.zh: 他下巴骨折，還掉了幾顆牙。

ex.en: Would you please replace the broken one promptly?
ex.zh: 可以請你儘快把壞掉的那個換掉嗎？

ex.en: There was a broken cup on the table.
ex.zh: 桌上有個破杯子。

ex.en: Using the data without permission is a breach of contract.
ex.zh: 未經許可使用資料是違約行為。

ex.en: He was fired for a serious breach of company rules.
ex.zh: 他因嚴重違反公司規定而被開除。

ex.en: More than 28 million Canadians were affected by privacy breaches last year.
ex.zh: 去年有超過 2,800 萬名加拿大人受到隱私外洩的影響。

ex.en: The bank reported a data breach last month.
ex.zh: 這家銀行上個月通報了資料外洩事件。
